rule: observed harness capability presence does not create authority; invocation-scoped direct permissions are proven using OpenCode v1 ordered rules where the last matching rule wins

direct_permission_boundary.read_scope: effective allow patterns must be contained in requested read_scope
direct_permission_boundary.write_scope: effective edit allow patterns must be contained in requested write_scope and write effect must be authorized
direct_permission_boundary.web: effective web allow is forbidden when request web=false
direct_permission_boundary.external_directory: effective allow is forbidden for repository-relative scopes
direct_permission_boundary.projection_precedence: projected direct rules must be observed intact; later direct rules must be deterministically classified as safely narrower, exact authorized duplicates, or isolated-runtime-root-only; unknown, ask, wildcard expansion or outside-root allow fails closed
direct_permission_boundary.diagnostic_evidence: sanitized effective direct rules, projection index, trailing rule classifications
